reason: The slow path needs optimizationLevel 2 or more, which neither ESLint nor Playwright sets (Playwright also bundles an affected 10.2.5 that npm can't see), and the patterns come only from this repository. The fix is in minimatch 11, which ESLint doesn't accept yet.
